Pull request: #445 Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000 Branch `bb/relay-180-batch-transcription-01-11-define-trans-thr_g3djwbjtg4` pushed to origin. ## Summary Implements issue #180: extends the Transcripts catalog with reserved computed keys, and adds the two ways a transcription job can be enqueued. - Registers `segments` and `summaryByInstruction` as reserved `items.computed` keys for Transcripts, guarded against future property-key collisions via `ComputedKeyRegistry`. - Adds a Files `onItemEvent:create` heartbeat action that enqueues `TASK_NAMES.transcriptionJob` for standalone `audio/*` files only — skipping files with an Emails.attachments edge and non-audio files — performing no item write. - Adds `POST /api/transcriptions` for explicitly requesting a transcription on any audio/video/legacy file, using the same job/key scheme; returns `409 transcription_exists` with the existing job's id on a repeat request. - Both producers share one job-key helper so repeated delivery from either path converges onto a single graphile-worker job. - The catalog's `status: 'error'` value and the user-owned N:N speakers-to-People relation were already present on `develop` from a prior blocking issue, so no further catalog change was needed there. ## Test plan - [x] `backend/pnpm run verify` (lint, format, build, unit, import-paths, migration numbering, write-safety, boundaries, integration, e2e) — passing - [x] `web/pnpm run verify` — passing - [x] New integration tests cover all acceptance criteria: standalone audio enqueues once, mail attachment does not enqueue, non-audio does not enqueue, repeated delivery converges on one job, explicit video request works, computed-key collision is enforced 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) Relay-Step-Status: pass
- 2026-09-19 14:16Z — Relay BB run pushed an update. Pull request: #445 Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000 Pushed the new commit to `bb/relay-180-batch-transcription-01-11-define-trans-thr_g3djwbjtg4` (already the branch backing PR #445). ## Summary This push addresses CI's code-review findings on PR #445 for issue #180 (transcription catalog, triggers, and action contracts): - **HIGH — input validation**: `requireFileItemId` now validates `fileItemId` with `z.string().uuid()` instead of a plain non-empty-string check, so a malformed id returns a 400 `ValidationError` rather than an unhandled 500 from Postgres's `22P02 invalid input syntax for type uuid`. - **LOW — dead code**: removed the unused `ItemRow` import and the unreachable `CustomRouteResult` union arm in `transcriptionRouteHandlers.ts`. - **AC #11**: `POST /api/transcriptions` now rejects any file whose blob mime type isn't `audio/*` or `video/*`, reusing the same `readBlobId` helper as the Files create-time trigger action. - **AC #4 / #15**: added `transcriptsCatalogCutoverMigration.ts`, a code-level migration following the repo's established `*CutoverMigration.ts` convention, which backfills the `status` `error` option and the `speakers`→People relation onto an already-provisioned Transcripts database (since `seedTenDatabases.ts` only ships that shape to a fresh install). Wired into both `runMigrationsCli.ts` (real deploy) and `testSupport/globalSetup.ts` (test parity), with a dedicated test covering the backfill, idempotency, and the "database not seeded yet" no-op. - **AC #2 / #3**: confirmed these were already correctly delivered in a prior commit; no code change needed beyond the migration mechanism above. Also added test coverage for the malformed-UUID and non-audio/video rejection paths, and fixed a write-safety-check finding (`requireAffectedRows` on the migration's two `UPDATE`s). Both `backend/pnpm run verify` (lint, format, build, unit, migration-numbering, write-safety, boundaries, integration, e2e — 1496/1496 tests) and `web/pnpm run verify` (lint, format, build, 197/197 tests) pass in full. Relay-Step-Status: pass

This push adds the fix for the review's one blocking finding on PR #445: AC #3 required the Transcripts→People `speakers` relation's edges to carry `{speaker: 'SPEAKER_00'}` metadata. The relation existed but no code validated or wrote that shape. Added `backend/packages/data/src/transcription/transcriptionSpeakerEdges.ts` with a zod-validated `writeTranscriptSpeakerEdge` that checks the target person exists in People and writes through the existing `createItemRelation` choke-point helper (no schema change needed — `item_relations.metadata` already existed), plus a full test file and an updated `seedTenDatabases.ts` comment pointing at the new write path. Both backend and web `pnpm run verify` pass cleanly (120/120 and 25/25 test files respectively, 1500/1500 and 197/197 tests, 0 failures). Relay-Step-Status: pass
